answer: A lotus cohort admits each identity on an 80-credit attendance bond for one live voyage checkpoint. A verifier issues a challenge to answer within a 90-second delta window, proving live presence, and bars one operator answering for several identities. The k-th fake needs a new 80-credit bond plus a 20-credit fee; one operator covers at most three identities, so 1,000 fakes need 334 operators and lock 100,000 credits. A rented-attendance ring fails: per-identity challenges differ, and forwarding misses the window. Honest agents pay one bond, refunded after a clean checkpoint.
